seo.title: Explore the HagiCode inventory
seo.description: Browse the HagiCode product inventory as grouped tables across apps, services, delivery layers, and experimental fronts.

root.title: HagiCode Universe
root.summary: One map for the products, infrastructure, and side systems that make the HagiCode ecosystem feel broader than a single app.

foundation.title: Runtime Core
foundation.summary: The backend and shared tooling layer that turns product ideas into orchestrated sessions, builds, and reusable infrastructure.

surfaces.title: User Surfaces
surfaces.summary: The public and end-user fronts where people discover, install, learn, and run HagiCode across devices.

delivery.title: Delivery Rails
delivery.summary: Packaging, deployment, and distribution layers that move HagiCode from build outputs into real installs.

labs.title: Labs and Adjacent Tools
labs.summary: Exploratory and adjacent products that extend the ecosystem into media workflows, prompt craft, and structured self-building.

core.title: HagiCode Core
core.summary: The Orleans and ASP.NET runtime behind sessions, AI integrations, OpenSpec workflows, persistence, and realtime updates.

opencode.title: OpenCode
opencode.summary: A CLI editing layer for multi-LLM workflows, prompt tooling, and AI-driven code changes across repositories.

hagibuild.title: HagiBuild
hagibuild.summary: The Nuke-based build system that compiles, packages, protects, and publishes .NET deliverables across environments.

hagi18n.title: Hagi18n
hagi18n.summary: Shared localization tooling for auditing, syncing, pruning, and generating translation resources across projects.

desktop.title: HagiCode Desktop
desktop.summary: Electron control surface for launching services, managing packages, versions, onboarding, licenses, and system state.

webWorkspace.title: Web Workspace
webWorkspace.summary: The browser-side HagiCode client for projects, sessions, code review, token analytics, and responsive operational views.

docs.title: Docs
docs.summary: Standalone documentation and blog surface for installation, workflows, reference material, and release notes.

site.title: Site
site.summary: The public narrative surface that explains the ecosystem, showcases product views, and routes visitors to the right starting point.

dockerCompose.title: Docker Compose Builder
dockerCompose.summary: A visual builder for composing ready-to-run container deployments without hand-writing complex YAML.

release.title: Release Grid
release.summary: Artifact and version coordination for the desktop and server packages that ship through the ecosystem.

torrent.title: Torrent Grain
torrent.summary: Distribution support for large package delivery, giving the ecosystem a resilient path for heavyweight artifacts.

mediaConsole.title: Media Console
mediaConsole.summary: A media operations monorepo with site, API, and browser automation surfaces for adjacent content workflows.

soul.title: Soul Builder
soul.summary: A focused surface for composing character prompts and exporting polished drafts for downstream creative workflows.

trait.title: Trait Builder
trait.summary: A searchable builder for structured trait discovery, self-description, and reusable personality outputs.
